findings.title: Strategy interface + factory + options type for a single implementation with one caller — a plain function does the job
findings.description: The change builds a DiscountStrategy interface, a BulkDiscountStrategy class, a DiscountStrategyFactory, and a factory-options type, all to apply one discount rule from one call site (applyBulkDiscount, consumed only by checkoutTotal). A single plain function holds the whole rule; the abstraction has no second implementation and no second consumer.

findings.title: Defensive null/undefined check on a number-typed parameter the type system makes impossible
findings.description: applyBulkDiscount(total: number) guards total === null || total === undefined, states its own signature already rules out. Dead defense: the branch cannot execute from any typed caller.
